evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3553923 ($400.07, product R, online) scores 0.01 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.27.
Card baseline from 192 earlier transactions: median $116.97, 95th percentile $799.93; the flagged amount is 3.4x the median.
Device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | edge 17.0 | 1920x1079' was used by this card before; identity record marks it Found.

Structuring: 3 online purchases between $400.05 and $400.08 within 9 minutes, each just under a $500 threshold, from 1 device profiles marked New. The bank's closed cases record the same shape five times (CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4086, CC-4124), all confirmed fraud and filed as undocumented. Measured on July-October, such bursts are fraud 9 times in 41 (likelihood ratio ~8).
Policy §6: Stop at probability >= 0.85 or <= 0.15 on two independent pieces of evidence, when a verification response settles it, or when further steps would not change the decision.
